crossRefs.note: He said, “Who made you a prince and a judge over us? Do you plan to kill me, as you killed the Egyptian?” Moses was…
Yahweh said to Moses in Midian, “Go, return into Egypt; for all the men who sought your life are dead.”
Moses took his wife and his sons, and set them on a donkey, and he returned to the land of Egypt. Moses took God’s rod…
Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, received Zipporah, Moses’ wife, after he had sent her away,

people.name: Midian
people.line: A nation descended from Abraham; oppressed Israel in the time of the judges

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses fled at this saying, and became a stranger in the land of Midian, where he became the father of two sons.
translations.bsb: At this remark, Moses fled to the land of Midian, where he lived as a foreigner and had two sons.
translations.kjv: Then fled Moses at this saying, and was a stranger in the land of Madian, where he begat two sons.
translations.asv: And Moses fled at this saying, and became a sojourner in the land of Midian, where he begat two sons.
